info.title: FlexPortal API
info.description:
FlexPortal is a subscription management platform for physical products like devices, equipment, and hardware. The API enables you to:

- **Orders**: Create and manage subscription orders for customers
- **Subscriptions**: Track active subscriptions, extend contracts, process buyouts and returns
- **Products**: Maintain your product catalog with variants, pricing tiers, and inventory
- **Customers**: Manage customer records and their subscription history
- **Assets**: Track individual devices by serial number through their lifecycle
- **Payments**: Monitor recurring payments and billing status
- **Billing Groups**: Consolidate subscriptions for B2B customers into single invoices

All endpoints require authentication via Bearer token and a Tenant-ID header. Responses use cursor-based pagination with `startAfter` and `limit` parameters.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Create and manage subscription orders. Orders flow through statuses: pending → confirmed → partial → fulfilled. Each order contains customer info, line items with products, and billing/shipping addresses.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Manage active subscriptions (rentals). Subscriptions link customers to specific assets and track billing. Support lifecycle operations including extensions, upgrades, buyouts, and early returns.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Maintain your product catalog. Products have variants (e.g., different grades/conditions) with pricing tiers for different contract lengths. Supports bulk CSV import and Shopify sync.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customer records with contact info, addresses, and subscription history. Customers can be individuals or businesses. Automatically created when processing orders with new email addresses.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Track physical devices/equipment by serial number. Assets flow through statuses: available → rented_out → returned. Link assets to subscriptions during order fulfillment.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Upload, download, and manage documents. Generate contracts from templates. Files are associated with orders and customers. Uses signed URLs for secure file transfers.

tags.name: Exports
tags.description: Export subscription data to CSV format for reporting, accounting integration, or business intelligence tools. Filter by status, date range, or customer.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Track recurring subscription payments. Payments are automatically generated based on billing schedules. Monitor payment status, handle failures, and mark manual payments as paid.

tags.name: Billing Groups
tags.description: Consolidate multiple subscriptions into a single monthly invoice for B2B customers. Set a common billing day and manage subscriptions as a group.

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from FlexPortal dashboard

post.description: Creates a new subscription order for a customer. The order goes through validation, pricing calculation, and customer lookup/creation. If no customer exists with the provided email, one is automatically created.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders.

schema.description: Filter by status (pending, confirmed, partial, fulfilled, cancelled)

get.description: Retrieves a specific order by ID.

patch.description: Updates the notes field on an order.

post.description: Cancels a pending order. Cannot cancel orders that have fulfilled subscriptions.
Bulk import products and variants from a CSV file. Supports up to ~500 products per request.

Creates a new product with its variants. Uses upsert logic - will update if product SKU already exists. Products can have multiple variants representing different conditions/grades, each with their own pricing tiers for different contract lengths.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of products in your catalog.
Returns all product variants. Useful for building pricing tables or dropdowns.

schema.description: Filter by grade (A, B, C, D, E)

get.description: Retrieves a specific product by ID, including its variants.

put.description: Updates an existing product and its variants.

delete.description: Soft deletes a product by setting status to discontinued. Also deactivates all associated variants.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of customers.
Retrieves a specific customer by ID.

put.description: Updates customer details such as name, phone, or addresses.

delete.description: Soft deletes a customer by setting status to inactive.

post.description: Creates a new subscription by assigning a specific asset (device) to a customer from an order. This is the order fulfillment step - it links a physical device (by serial number) to a line item in an order, creating an active subscription.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of subscriptions.

schema.description: Filter by status (active, cancelled, ended_completed, ended_buyout, ended_upgrade, ended_early_return)

get.description: Retrieves a specific subscription by ID.

post.description: Customer purchases the device, ending the subscription.
Extends the subscription contract length.
Upgrades the customer to a better device. Creates a new subscription and ends the current one.
Replaces the device on a subscription (e.g., for warranty or damage).
Customer returns the device before contract end. May incur early return fees.
Cancels an active subscription. Use when customer wants to end subscription without returning device immediately.

patch.description: Updates the notes field on a subscription.

post.description: Calculates the buyout price for a subscription without performing the buyout.
Calculates the early return fee for a subscription without performing the return.
Registers a new device/asset in inventory. Each asset is identified by a unique serial number. Assets start as "available" and can be assigned to subscriptions during order fulfillment.

example.productName: MacBook Pro 16" M3 Pro - Grade A

get.description: Returns a paginated list of assets in inventory.

schema.description: Filter by status (available, rented_out, returned, sold, unavailable)

get.description: Retrieves a specific asset by serial number.

put.description: Updates asset details such as status, location, or notes.

delete.description: Soft deletes an asset by setting status to unavailable.

get.description: Returns a list of files with optional filtering by order or type.
Retrieves metadata for a specific file. Does not return the file content.

delete.description: Deletes a file record and optionally removes from storage.

post.description: Generates a signed URL for viewing or downloading a file. URLs expire after the specified time.
Generates a PDF contract for an order using tenant-configured templates.
Exports rental/subscription data to CSV format with optional date range and field filtering.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payments with optional filtering by status, customer, or rental.

schema.description: Filter by status (pending, processing, paid, failed, cancelled)

get.description: Retrieves a specific payment by ID.

post.description: Manually marks a payment as paid. Use for offline payments (check, wire transfer, cash).
Cancels a pending payment. Cannot cancel already paid or processing payments.

get.description: Returns a list of billing groups for consolidated B2B billing.

post.description: Creates a new billing group for consolidated B2B billing. Groups multiple subscriptions under one customer for a single monthly invoice. All subscriptions in the group are billed on the same day each month.

get.description: Retrieves a specific billing group by ID.

patch.description: Updates billing group settings. Can add/remove rentals, change billing day, or update name.

delete.description: Deletes a billing group. Rentals are moved back to individual billing.
